a cruel society.text: Some horrors are made long before the monster appears, by greed, war, prejudice or the plain cruelty of being shunned. Here the threat grows out of what people do to one another together. In Tualang Tiga [the hunchback Si Bongkok paints beautifully but is shunned for his ugly face|1958-sumpah-orang-minyak], and when he breaks his oath the devil is waiting with a bargain. In Francoist Spain [Captain Vidal tortures and kills to crush the Maquis|2006-pan-s-labyrinth] while Ofelia follows a fairy into a stone labyrinth. In upstate New York [the Black staff behave eerily and wealthy white guests bid on Chris's photograph|2017-get-out].

a mind turning on itself.text: Here nothing comes from outside. The threat is born in a mind under strain, through madness, repression, fever or the nearness of death, and it has grown more common lately, with a third of its films made since 2015. At Bly [the new governess sees a man and a woman in the grounds that only she seems to notice|1961-the-innocents]. On Baltrum [Johan Borg barely sleeps and sketches the Birdman and the Meat-Eaters who torment him|1968-hour-of-the-wolf]. And [Philip Goodman, who debunks psychics on television, is handed three cases to solve|2017-ghost-stories] by a boyhood hero now living sick in a caravan.

bargains with dark powers.text: The bargain is the oldest temptation: you name what you want, and something dark names its price. More than half these pacts come from films made since 2015, and Southeast Asia returns to them again and again. The Le Domas fortune rests on [a great-grandfather's deal with the mysterious Le Bail, called in on Grace's wedding night|2019-ready-or-not]. In the Indonesian countryside [a fertility cult answers barren women's prayers, and its price is the last child|2017-satan-s-slaves]. In Tualang Tiga [the devil offers Si Bongkok a false bargain|1958-sumpah-orang-minyak] once his beauty has turned invisible to everyone.

caught from another.text: This fear travels by touch. A bite, an infection, sex or a single act of witnessing passes it from one victim to the next, and whoever survives may carry it on. Most of these films were made between 1980 and 2014. In Cambridge [the rage virus leaps from a freed chimpanzee to its rescuers within seconds|2002-28-days-later]. In 1791 Louisiana [Lestat turns a dying plague orphan named Claudia|1994-interview-with-the-vampire] to keep Louis at his side. In nineteenth-century Serbia [the wurdalak preys on the people it loved|1963-black-sabbath], and soon a dead child begs at the door to be let in.

curses laid by others.text: A curse is harm with an author, someone who knew exactly what they were doing: a sorcerer, a witch, a wronged party settling a debt. On a Rhode Island farm [the Warrens learn the land bears the curse of a witch who sacrificed her baby|2013-the-conjuring]. In Bali [the Queen of the Leák carves a spell into Cathy's thigh|1981-mystics-in-bali] and meets her at midnight in the graveyard. In Harjosari [babies are born without skin, and the curse leads back to three murdered girls|2019-impetigore]. The fear is small and evenly spread, sixteen films scattered across the century.

deliberately called up.text: Someone always says the words. This fear begins with a choice, a ritual, a book read aloud, a spirit board, a wish, and it is rising, with sixteen films since 2015 alone. In a remote cabin [Eric reads an old book's incantation aloud|2013-evil-dead], and soon Mia is scalding herself in the shower. In Georgetown [Regan finds a spirit board and talks with someone she calls Captain Howdy|1973-the-exorcist]. In Los Angeles [Sarah and three outcast girls call on Manon to cast their spells|1996-the-craft], and in Adelaide [teenagers grip an embalmed hand and say talk to me|2022-talk-to-me].

evil outliving death.text: Death should end a wicked life. In these films the executed witch, the murdered killer and the cult founder simply carry on. The fear belongs to the 1960s through the 1990s and has vanished from films made since 2015. In Moldavia [the witch Asa Vajda, sentenced to death by her own brother, wakes when a doctor's blood falls on her corpse|1960-black-sunday]. On Elm Street [Fred Krueger, burned alive by the parents, comes for their children in their sleep|1984-a-nightmare-on-elm-street]. And in Veerana [the dead witch Nakita's spirit enters little Jasmin at the tomb|1988-veerana].

family blood and inheritance.text: What runs in the family cannot be left at the door. Here the threat is inherited, taught by relatives or kept as a family secret, and it has surged recently, with seventeen of its films made since 2015. After her secretive mother's funeral, [Annie Graham watches grief settle over her family|2018-hereditary]. At veterinary school [Justine's hunger proves to be an appetite that runs in the family|2016-raw]. Irena [believes she descends from a village of cat people|1942-cat-people], and in Chandanghat [Kumar comes home to the tree where his father and grandfather were killed|1962-bees-saal-baad].

from another world.text: Some horrors arrive through a door that should have stayed shut, from the sky, from another dimension or from hell itself. In Antarctica the men learn [the thing was found near a spacecraft buried for over a hundred thousand years|1982-the-thing]. In Florida [a glimmering zone keeps spreading from a lighthouse where a meteor fell|2018-annihilation]. Under a New Orleans hotel [a plumber breaks into a bricked-off space and the dead begin to walk|1981-the-beyond], and in Francoist Spain a faun hails Ofelia as a lost princess of the underworld. North America makes more than half of these films.

grief that will not end.text: Grief should soften with time. In these films it hardens instead, into obsession, madness or revenge. The loss is most often a child, and the mourner is often a parent whose sorrow turns to rage or to vengeance. The fear does not appear before 1960 and gathers in the 2000s, through Calvaire, Inside, Antichrist and Goodnight Mommy. It reaches back to Sisters and Phantasm in the 1970s and forward to The Invitation, Don't Breathe and Bring Her Back.

guilt and punishment.text: Guilt is a debt the conscience keeps on its books, and in these films it falls due. A sin, a crime or a broken vow comes back on the one who committed it. Marion Crane [steals $40,000, and a rainstorm forces her to stop at the Bates Motel|1960-psycho]. The undertaker [Zé do Caixão scorns religion, and a gypsy warns that at midnight the ghosts of those he murdered will come|1964-at-midnight-i-ll-take-your-soul]. In Tualang Tiga [Si Bongkok breaks his oath never to kill|1958-sumpah-orang-minyak]. East Asia, with five of these twelve films, returns to the reckoning most.

harm done in childhood.text: The wound comes first, and the horror grows from it years later. Abuse, violence or a parent's damage in childhood shapes the threat, and the fear first appears in the 1960s and has stayed in every era since. Locked in a circus trailer, [the boy Fénix watches his father cut off his mother's arms|1989-santa-sangre]. In Audition, [the burn scars Asami carries from childhood hint at what she demands|1999-audition]. In Woodsboro [Sidney Prescott dreads the first anniversary of her mother's rape and murder|1996-scream] as the calls begin.

monsters people made.text: These monsters have makers: a scientist, a laboratory, a corporation, a poisoned river. The fear was strongest at the start, with fourteen of the forty-one films made before 1960, and East Asia returns to it often. On a South Seas island [Dr. Moreau surgically shapes animals into people|1932-island-of-lost-souls]. In Seoul [a creature is born of formaldehyde poured down a drain into the Han River|2006-the-host]. In Ringu [Sadako's rage was recorded onto a tape that kills its viewers in seven days|1998-ringu], and in a Cambridge laboratory activists free a chimpanzee infected with rage.

nature itself.text: Nature needs no motive. The sea, the wilderness and whatever lives deep underground are simply there, indifferent, and the fear has quickened recently, with eleven films since 2015. Carl Denham sails toward [an uncharted island where Ann Darrow is offered as the bride of Kong|1933-king-kong]. Beside a great Irish forest [Adam finds an animal carcass burst open by a strange fungus|2015-the-hallow]. In the Appalachian dark [pale, blind creatures hunt by sound|2005-the-descent], and in the outback [a giant boar smashes through Jake Cullen's house and carries off his grandson|1984-razorback].

no known source.text: The hardest answer to bear is no answer. In these films the threat has no origin the story will give, or one beyond human understanding, and that silence has grown more common, from a single film before 1960 to eighteen since 2015. Beneath Hanging Rock [the girls who walk into a crevice in the stone are never found|1975-picnic-at-hanging-rock], all but Irma. In Kurouzu-cho [a whole town is caught in the spiral|2000-uzumaki]. At an Austrian lake house [two polite young men hold a family hostage through one long night|1997-funny-games], and no reason is ever offered.

old beliefs and legends.text: Old stories wait for the night someone stops believing they are only stories. Folklore, myth, prophecy and superstition feed this fear, and it travels unusually widely, with as many films from Continental Europe as from North America. At a Malaysian girls' school [Zaffan glimpses a pink-eyed jungle woman from an old warning tale|2023-tiger-stripes]. In wartime Tehran [a neighbour boy's tale of djinn starts to seem true|2016-under-the-shadow]. In Tumbbad a forgotten god lives inside the womb of the goddess of prosperity, and in Guatemala [an old dictator hears a woman weeping at night|2019-la-llorona].

old things disturbed.text: Some things were sealed away for a reason. This fear begins when someone digs, opens, reads or steals, and the old thing wakes. It peaks in the 1980s and 90s. In Antarctica the men learn [the organism came from a spacecraft buried for over a hundred thousand years|1982-the-thing]. In Black Sabbath [a nurse preparing a body for burial slips a valuable ring from the corpse|1963-black-sabbath]. In a Pennsylvania attic [Ellison Oswalt finds a box of Super 8 reels labelled as home movies|2012-sinister], and on a bus [Joy Ramirez picks up a bagua mirror a passenger left behind|2004-feng-shui].

ordinary people who kill.text: Sometimes there is nothing behind the horror at all, only a person and a crime. These films stay close to real cases and ordinary killers, and the fear is rare, nine films in the record, two thirds of them North American. In Haddonfield [Michael Myers, who stabbed his sister to death as a child, comes home for Halloween in a mask stolen from a hardware store|1978-halloween], and shadows Laurie Strode through the day. The same cold plainness runs through Les Diaboliques, The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, Wolf Creek and Green Room.

places with dark pasts.text: A place can remember. The house, the land or the building carries its burials and murders forward and waits for the next family to move in. The fear peaks in the 1960s and 70s and has grown rare since 2015. Hill House is [a mansion where Hugh Crain's wives, his daughter and her companion all died|1963-the-haunting]. At 112 Ocean Avenue [the Lutzes move in a year after Ronald DeFeo Jr. shot his whole family there|1979-the-amityville-horror]. In Freiburg Suzy learns that [her dance academy was founded by a woman said to be a witch|1977-suspiria].

secret worshippers among us.text: The secret worshippers keep their faith behind ordinary doors. A cult, a coven or a close-knit community holds something dark at its centre, and the fear clusters after 2000, in fifteen of its twenty-two films. On a remote Welsh island [the island's goddess lies bound in tree roots in a barn and is fed on blood|2018-apostle]. In Tumbbad [Vinayak returns hungry for the treasure of a forgotten god|2018-tumbbad]. In Kurouzu-cho [Shuichi's father fills a video scrapbook with anything that curls|2000-uzumaki], until the whole town is caught in the spiral.

stories come true.text: Here the fiction leaks. A horror film, a television show or a story people believe in becomes the thing that kills, and the fear is a creature of the 1980s and 90s, with six of its eight films. In Woodsboro [a caller's chat about horror films turns sadistic|1996-scream], and at a party in a secluded house film buff Randy lays out the rules. Tenebrae, Demons, In the Mouth of Madness and Wes Craven's New Nightmare share that era, and Host and I Saw the TV Glow bring the fear back in the 2020s.

strangers who arrive.text: The stranger is the oldest threat at the gate: someone from elsewhere, someone escaped, someone let in. Count Orlok [sails for Wisborg among coffins full of rats|1922-nosferatu]. [Soon after a Japanese stranger arrives in Gokseong|2016-the-wailing], villagers begin killing their own families. Michael Myers escapes a sanitarium and [comes home to Haddonfield in a white mask|1978-halloween], and in Blackeberg [Eli moves in next door to Oskar and asks to be invited in|2008-let-the-right-one-in]. North America accounts for more than half these films.

the body changing or damaged.text: The body is meant to be the one place we live without fear, and here it becomes the source: puberty, pregnancy, injury, an unnatural birth. At an all-girls school [Zaffan's first period arrives, her skin breaks out and her nails start to fall away|2023-tiger-stripes]. At a Swiss academy [insects are drawn to Jennifer Corvino as if by telepathy|1985-phenomena], and she summons a swarm of flies over the school. In a derelict bathroom [Adam and Lawrence find hacksaws too weak for their chains|2004-saw]. Continental Europe makes nearly a third of these films.

the wronged dead return.text: The wronged dead are owed something, and they come back to collect. An innocent life ended unjustly or violently, and the haunting is what it became. The fear peaks in the early 2000s and lives above all in Asia, in nearly half the East Asian films and more than half of those from South Asia. In Antonio Bay [a glowing fog carries back the drowned crew of the ship the town's founders wrecked|1980-the-fog]. In Dakar [the builders who went months without pay return inside the bodies of the living|2019-atlantics], and in Chanderi [men stay indoors after ten because a woman's spirit takes them|2018-stree].
